caption: How a BuildRegs enquiry becomes a paid job — without anyone copying anything by hand.

label: STEP 1
title: A customer submits their plans
caption: A customer fills in one form and attaches their drawings. That is everything they have to do.

label: STEP 2
title: Within seconds, they get a branded acknowledgement
body:
Thanks — we've received your enquiry

Hi Sarah,

Thank you for getting in touch with BuildRegs. Your enquiry is with our technical team, who will review the details and prepare your quotation.

What happens next

1We review your plans and project details.
2We send you a fixed-fee quotation setting out exactly what's included.
3Once you're happy, you accept online and we begin your drawings.

If anything about your project changes in the meantime, just reply to this email and quote your reference.

Kind regards,
The BuildRegs Team

Nothing copied by hand. No files lost. No enquiry forgotten.
